parameters.jsCode:
const concepts = [
  { term: 'Die Verhandlungsbasis', gloss: 'negotiation basis' },
  { term: 'Der Wettbewerbsvorteil', gloss: 'competitive advantage' },
  { term: 'Die Marktdurchdringung', gloss: 'market penetration' },
  { term: 'Der Meilenstein', gloss: 'milestone' },
  { term: 'Die Effizienzsteigerung', gloss: 'efficiency increase' },
  { term: 'Die Wertschöpfungskette', gloss: 'value chain' },
  { term: 'Der Umsatzrückgang', gloss: 'decline in revenue' },
  { term: 'Die Kundenbindung', gloss: 'customer retention' },
  { term: 'Die Kostensenkung', gloss: 'cost reduction' },
  { term: 'Das Alleinstellungsmerkmal', gloss: 'unique selling point' },
  { term: 'Die Zielvorgabe', gloss: 'target / objective' },
  { term: 'Der Handlungsbedarf', gloss: 'need for action' },
  { term: 'Die Rentabilität', gloss: 'profitability' },
  { term: 'Die Nachhaltigkeit', gloss: 'sustainability' },
  { term: 'Der Geschäftsbericht', gloss: 'annual report' },
  { term: 'Die Kennzahl', gloss: 'key figure / KPI' },
  { term: 'Die Umstrukturierung', gloss: 'restructuring' },
  { term: 'Der Engpass', gloss: 'bottleneck' },
  { term: 'Die Ausschreibung', gloss: 'call for tenders' },
  { term: 'Das Lastenheft', gloss: 'requirements specification' },
  { term: 'Die Zuständigkeit', gloss: 'area of responsibility' },
  { term: 'Die Abstimmung', gloss: 'alignment / coordination' },
  { term: 'Der Entscheidungsträger', gloss: 'decision-maker' },
  { term: 'Die Risikobewertung', gloss: 'risk assessment' },
  { term: 'Die Stellschraube', gloss: 'lever to adjust' },
  { term: 'Der Mehrwert', gloss: 'added value' },
  { term: 'Die Wachstumsstrategie', gloss: 'growth strategy' },
  { term: 'Das Kerngeschäft', gloss: 'core business' },
  { term: 'Die Fusion', gloss: 'merger' },
  { term: 'Die Übernahme', gloss: 'takeover / acquisition' },
  { term: 'Der Marktanteil', gloss: 'market share' },
  { term: 'Die Absatzprognose', gloss: 'sales forecast' },
  { term: 'Die Liquidität', gloss: 'liquidity' },
  { term: 'Die Rahmenbedingungen', gloss: 'framework conditions' },
  { term: 'Der Lieferengpass', gloss: 'supply bottleneck' },
  { term: 'Die Prozessoptimierung', gloss: 'process optimisation' },
  { term: 'Die Personalentwicklung', gloss: 'staff development' },
  { term: 'Die Unternehmenskultur', gloss: 'corporate culture' },
  { term: 'Der Interessenkonflikt', gloss: 'conflict of interest' },
  { term: 'Die Machbarkeitsstudie', gloss: 'feasibility study' },
  { term: 'Die Zwischenbilanz', gloss: 'interim review' },
  { term: 'Der Spielraum', gloss: 'room for manoeuvre' },
  { term: 'Die Tragweite', gloss: 'implications / scope' },
  { term: 'Die Weichenstellung', gloss: 'setting the course' },
  { term: 'Der Kurswechsel', gloss: 'change of course' },
  { term: 'Die Nachfrage', gloss: 'demand' },
  { term: 'Das Einsparpotenzial', gloss: 'savings potential' },
  { term: 'Die Kundenzufriedenheit', gloss: 'customer satisfaction' },
  { term: 'Die Geschäftsleitung', gloss: 'executive management' },
  { term: 'Der Ansprechpartner', gloss: 'point of contact' },
  { term: 'Die Vereinbarung', gloss: 'agreement' },
  { term: 'Die Frist', gloss: 'deadline' },
  { term: 'Die Haftung', gloss: 'liability' },
  { term: 'Die Skalierbarkeit', gloss: 'scalability' },
  { term: 'Die Digitalisierung', gloss: 'digitalisation' },
  { term: 'Der Umsatztreiber', gloss: 'revenue driver' },
  { term: 'Die Auslastung', gloss: 'capacity utilisation' },
  { term: 'Die Gewinnspanne', gloss: 'profit margin' },
  { term: 'Die Zielgruppe', gloss: 'target group' },
  { term: 'Der Wettbewerbsdruck', gloss: 'competitive pressure' },
];
const today = new Date();
const dateStr = today.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
const dayName = today.toLocaleDateString('de-DE', { weekday: 'long' });
// Rotate one step per calendar day, then start over
const dayNumber = Math.floor(Date.UTC(today.getFullYear(), today.getMonth(), today.getDate()) / 86400000);
const concept = concepts[dayNumber % concepts.length];
return [
  {
    json: {
      date: dateStr,
      dayName,
      concept: concept.term,
      gloss: concept.gloss,
    },
  },
];

parameters.text: =Today is {{ $json.dayName }}, {{ $json.date }}. Today's business concept: {{ $json.concept }} ({{ $json.gloss }}). Create today's C1 German business language boost.

options.systemMessage:
You are an elite German language coach for C1-level business professionals. For each request you receive one high-level German business concept. Produce one daily language boost structured exactly with these sections and headings:

WORD OF THE DAY: the given business concept, with a short English gloss.

IN CONTEXT: one professional, C1-level corporate presentation scenario paragraph in German (4-6 sentences) — e.g. a slide narration, boardroom pitch or quarterly review — in which a native-speaking executive uses the concept organically and persuasively.

YOUR CHALLENGE: one interactive sentence-building challenge: give the learner a concrete business situation and ask them to write a sentence (or short spoken response) using the concept, optionally with a hint. End with an encouraging line inviting them to try.

Rules: keep everything at genuine C1 register, formal business German (Sie-Form where people are addressed); authentic corporate tone, no bullet-point overload, readable on a phone.
